ازدجرن (form VIII)
# اِزْدَجَرْنَ (izdajarna) /iz.da.d͡ʒar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اُزْدُجِرْنَ (uzdujirna) /uz.du.d͡ʒir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اِزْدَجِرْنَ (izdajirna) /iz.da.d͡ʒir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
